Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Thomas Jefferson Farnham (author, Wikidata Q7791057), died 1848; Pierre-Jean de Smet (author, Wikidata Q981962), died 1873; Reuben Gold Thwaites (editor, Wikidata Q7317451), died 1913. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Farnham, Thomas Jefferson, 1804-1848; Smet, Pierre-Jean de, 1801-1873; Thwaites, Reuben Gold, 1853-1913 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: De Smet's Oregon Missions and Travels Over the Rocky Mountains, 1845-1846, 1906, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/desmetsoregonmi00smetgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 71%, 79%, 39% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
